turns.assessment: The simultaneous OCH_LOS and client/protection alarms indicate a shared hard optical blockage, not an individual svc375 client-port or OTN cross-connect fault. Power, OSNR, and amplifier telemetry on both S13–S23 directions remained unchanged, strongly arguing against a fibre, connector, or amplifier failure. A WSS input-port failure at either bounding ROADM remains compatible because the incoming line monitor can stay normal while channels are blocked inside the node; the observations do not identify which end failed.

proposals.rationale: A failed WSS input port at roadm.S13 could block all channels arriving on the affected degree while the S13 incoming OCM and line amplifiers continue reporting unchanged power and OSNR.
A failed WSS input port at roadm.S23 gives the same hard multi-channel loss pattern while remaining consistent with unchanged incoming OCM and amplifier measurements.
